statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
The service addresses diagnoses I49.9 and R00.2.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to service delivery.
